Introduction

Complete API documentation for Marketplace Nigeria platform

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8030 
This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

<aside>As you scroll, you'll see code examples for working with the API in different programming languages in the dark area to the right (or as part of the content on mobile).
You can switch the language used with the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu at the top left on mobile).</aside>

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Advert Statistics

APIs for retrieving advertisement statistics, counts, and filtering

Get adverts count with filters

requires authentication

Returns the total count of active adverts based on various filters. All filters are optional and can be combined.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/count?category=1&sub_category=5&brand=10&buy_direct=Yes&state=Lagos&from_date=2025-01-01&to_date=2025-01-31" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/count"
);

const params = {
    "category": "1",
    "sub_category": "5",
    "brand": "10",
    "buy_direct": "Yes",
    "state": "Lagos",
    "from_date": "2025-01-01",
    "to_date": "2025-01-31",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200):


{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "total_count": 1500,
        "filters_applied": {
            "category": "1",
            "state": "Lagos"
        }
    }
}

Example response (500):


{
    "success": false,
    "message": "Failed to fetch advert count",
    "error": "Error details"
}
Received response:
Request failed with error:


Tip: Check that you're properly connected to the network.
If you're a maintainer of ths API, verify that your API is running and you've enabled CORS.
You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

Request      

GET api/adverts/count

Headers

Authorization        

Example: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

Query Parameters

category   integer  optional    

The category ID. Example: 1

sub_category   integer  optional    

The sub-category ID. Example: 5

brand   integer  optional    

The brand ID. Example: 10

buy_direct   string  optional    

Filter by buy direct option. Use "Yes" or "No". Example: Yes

state   string  optional    

The state name. Example: Lagos

from_date   string  optional    

date Filter adverts from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2025-01-01

to_date   string  optional    

date Filter adverts to this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2025-01-31

Get adverts grouped by state

requires authentication

Returns the count of active adverts grouped by Nigerian states. Results are ordered by state with the most adverts first.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/by-state?category=1&sub_category=5&brand=10" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/by-state"
);

const params = {
    "category": "1",
    "sub_category": "5",
    "brand": "10",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200):


{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "states": [
            {
                "state": "Lagos",
                "total": 500
            },
            {
                "state": "Abuja",
                "total": 300
            },
            {
                "state": "Port Harcourt",
                "total": 250
            }
        ],
        "filters_applied": {
            "category": "1"
        }
    }
}

Example response (500):


{
    "success": false,
    "message": "Failed to fetch adverts by state",
    "error": "Error details"
}

Get advert count filtered by verified sellers

requires authentication

Returns the count of adverts from verified or unverified sellers. Useful for showing marketplace trust metrics.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/count-filtered?verified=yes&category=electronics&sub_category=mobile-phones&brand=samsung" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/count-filtered"
);

const params = {
    "verified": "yes",
    "category": "electronics",
    "sub_category": "mobile-phones",
    "brand": "samsung",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200):


{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "count": 250,
        "verified": "yes",
        "category": "electronics",
        "sub_category": "mobile-phones",
        "brand": "samsung"
    }
}

Example response (500):


{
    "success": false,
    "message": "Failed to fetch filtered advert count",
    "error": "Error details"
}

Get brands with advert counts

requires authentication

Returns a list of brands with their active advert counts. Can be filtered by category or sub-category. Only returns brands with at least one active advert.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/brands?category_id=1&sub_category_id=5" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/adverts/brands"
);

const params = {
    "category_id": "1",
    "sub_category_id": "5",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200):


{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "brands": [
            {
                "id": 1,
                "brand_name": "Samsung",
                "brand_slug": "samsung",
                "adverts_count": 45,
                "sub_category": {
                    "id": 5,
                    "sub_cat_name": "Mobile Phones",
                    "category": {
                        "id": 1,
                        "category_name": "Electronics"
                    }
                }
            },
            {
                "id": 2,
                "brand_name": "Apple",
                "brand_slug": "apple",
                "adverts_count": 38,
                "sub_category": {
                    "id": 5,
                    "sub_cat_name": "Mobile Phones",
                    "category": {
                        "id": 1,
                        "category_name": "Electronics"
                    }
                }
            }
        ],
        "category_id": 1,
        "sub_category_id": 5
    }
}

Example response (500):

    "success": false,
    "message": "Failed to fetch brands with advert count",

POST api/device-tokens

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/device-tokens" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"token\": \"lpntfa\",
    \"platform\": \"soluta\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/device-tokens"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "token": "lpntfa",
    "platform": "soluta"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Get user notifications

requires authentication

Retrieves notifications for the authenticated user with pagination support. Returns both the notifications list and unread count.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/user/notifications?limit=20" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/user/notifications"
);

const params = {
    "limit": "20",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
